Variance = E[x²]-mean² in fp32: squares ~524288, cancellation: variance ≈ 0.0156 (0.125²). squares/N ~ 4096+0.0156... rounding error in squares sum ~ 524288*2^-24*sqrt? Worst case error ~ few * 524288*6e-8 ≈ 0.03 per accumulation? Actually error ~ N * eps * max ≈ 128*524288*6e-8 ≈ 4. So variance error could be ~4/128 = 0.03 vs variance 0.0156! That could be catastrophic cancellation. Hmm, relative error of squares sum: fp32 relative error accumulation ~ sqrt(128)*6e-8*524288 ≈ 0.00035 — random walk. Divided by 128 → variance error ~ 3e-6, relative to 0.0156 → 2e-4. OK fine. Sum error similar magnitude small.
